behaviors.name: Audio Cue
behaviors.description: Plays a sound when a game-state key changes.

properties.label: State key
properties.description: The sound plays whenever this key changes.

behaviors.name: Racer Chase Camera
behaviors.description: Low chase camera that banks into turns and pulls back with speed. Reads the player craft written by Racer Craft.

properties.label: Target
properties.description: Craft to follow. Defaults to the entity named "Player".

properties.label: Look ahead
properties.description: Metres in front of the craft the camera aims at.

properties.label: Bank amount
properties.description: How much of the craft's roll the camera copies.

properties.label: Speed pull-back
properties.description: Extra distance per m/s of craft speed.

behaviors.name: Racer Craft
behaviors.description: Anti-gravity hover craft with drift, air brakes, boost, weapons and shields. Pilot it or hand it to an AI rival.

properties.label: Pilot
properties.description: Who flies this craft.

properties.label: Craft class
properties.description: speeder: fragile and fast. interceptor: balanced. bulwark: heavy and armoured.

properties.label: Waypoint prefix
properties.description: Waypoints are entities named "<prefix> 01", "<prefix> 02", … in lap order. Number 01 is the start line.

properties.label: Speeder visual
properties.description: Child entity shown when the speeder class is selected.

properties.label: Interceptor visual
properties.description: Child entity shown when the interceptor class is selected.

properties.label: Bulwark visual
properties.description: Child entity shown when the bulwark class is selected.

properties.label: Pulse bolt entity
properties.description: Scene entity animated as this craft's pulse cannon shot.

properties.label: Hover height
properties.description: Distance the collider centre rides above the track surface.

properties.label: Respawn below Y
properties.description: A craft that falls below this height is put back on the track.

properties.label: Speed scale
properties.description: Multiplies the class top speed and acceleration.

properties.label: Boost charge
properties.description: Boost meter at the start of the race.

properties.label: AI skill
properties.description: Rival only: pace and precision.

properties.label: AI aggression
properties.description: Rival only: how eagerly it rams and fires at the player.

properties.label: Lane offset
properties.description: Rival only: metres right of the waypoint line it prefers.

properties.label: Rubber banding
properties.description: Rival only: speed bonus per waypoint it trails the player by.

behaviors.name: Race Director
behaviors.description: Runs the countdown, ranks every craft by lap progress, and shows the win or lose overlay when the player finishes.

properties.label: Craft entity names
properties.description: Comma-separated names of every racing craft, player included.

properties.label: Podium places
properties.description: Finishing at or above this place counts as a win.

behaviors.name: Racer Pickup
behaviors.description: Grants a weapon, shield, energy or boost to any craft that flies through it, then respawns.

properties.label: Respawn after (s)
properties.description: 0 keeps the pickup active for everyone, with a short per-craft cooldown (boost pads).
